# The Technology Framework

> AI enablement across every dimension of IT, for UK firms of 20-200 people. Everyone says adopt AI; nobody owns making the firm ready. One framework makes all ten dimensions of IT AI-ready, run by a named Head of IT, one or two days a week. The proof you can dial: the practice's own phone line is answered by its own AI call agent, in production.

- Official site: https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/
- Legal name: The Technology Framework Ltd

- Registered office: 20-22 Wenlock Road, London N1 7GU
- Public phone: 0117 456 5486
- Email: hello@thetechnologyframework.com

The Technology Framework is a standalone practice, independent of MSPs and vendors: it sells no licences and takes no vendor margin. Clients keep their MSP if it works; the practice sits above it. Prices are published; most firms in this market keep them behind a discovery call.

## Services and published prices

- [AI Opportunity Audit](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/ai-opportunity-audit/): the front door. Workflows timed and costed, AI use-cases scored on return, risk and data readiness, a sequenced roadmap with the first build costed. From £4,950 fixed, two to three weeks.
- [Fractional Head of IT & AI](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/fractional-head-of-it/): the seat on the leadership team, owning the estate and the AI agenda. From £4,750 a month for one day a week. Fractional or interim, occasionally permanent for the right firm.
- [Cyber Essentials Plus and ISO 27001](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/cyber-essentials-iso-27001/): we implement the controls; an accredited assessor certifies. CE+ readiness from £2,950 fixed. ISO 27001 implementation from £15,000. ISO 42001 (AI management) readiness from £6,500. The Cyber Essentials scheme gets harder from 26 April 2026 (MFA on all cloud services, 14-day critical patching).
- [Microsoft Copilot readiness](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/microsoft-copilot-readiness/): independent Copilot governance from a practice with no licences to sell. Tenant first, then a 30-day pilot. Fixed fee from £7,500 for 50-250 seats.
- [Technology cost reduction](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/technology-cost-reduction/): cloud, licences, vendor contracts and telephony, read the way a finance director reads them. From £4,950 fixed, with a share-of-savings option on contract and licensing work. The plainest way to fund the AI programme.
- [Production IT agent](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/production-it-agent/): one workflow, live and earning its keep, measured against one KPI. Fixed fee from £7,500.


## The framework

Ten dimensions of IT, each made AI-ready and each with an owner: cost, cyber security, compliance, infrastructure, operations, vendor management, AI, data, analytics, software development. The seat covers all ten; any single dimension can be owned on its own, priced in conversation.

## Who we work with

Firms of 20-200 people in professional and financial services (law, accountancy, consultancy, wealth and advice firms, including the consolidators integrating acquired advice firms), and PE-backed or acquisitive businesses. Law firms of 30-100 staff buy the certification work as a product.

- https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/who-we-work-with/
- https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/south-west-wealth-ifa/
- https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/law-firm-it-security/
- https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/professional-services-it/

Dated hooks that matter to buyers: criminal legal aid contracts have required Cyber Essentials since 1 October 2025 (Legal Aid Agency, 2025 Standard Crime Contract). The FCA's operational incident and third-party reporting rules were finalised in March 2026 and come into force on 18 March 2027; most FCA-authorised firms, advice firms included, are in the standard reporting tier.

## How we work

Diagnose. Deliver. Decide. First we listen. Then visible progress in bounded sprints, scoped at diagnose (the audit is the shortest, two to three weeks). Then it is the client's call: keep the seat filled, or keep the gains and run it in-house.
https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/how-we-work/
